summary: Add practice for the specification's squared-sine equation and make the quadratic branch checks and chapter links explicit.

improvements.where: P2-6.2 teaching card and note, after ## Method
improvements.why: Pearson's P2 specification gives $\sin^2(x+\pi/6)=1/2$ on $-\pi\le x<\pi$; the bundle and current item i12 instead use unsquared sine, so the specified two-sign step has no worked treatment.
improvements.what: Add a worked walkthrough for the squared equation: set $u=x+\pi/6$, transform the interval, take $\sin u=\pm1/\sqrt{2}$, list all eligible $u$, then recover and check $x$. Keep existing i12 unchanged.

improvements.why: No item tests the official squared-sine example; the existing unsquared item checks only one sign.
improvements.what: Add one exam-style Find item for $\sin^2(x+\pi/6)=1/2$ on $-\pi\le x<\pi$, plus one misconception MCQ that distinguishes $\sin u=\pm\sqrt{c}$ from $\sin u=+\sqrt{c}$ and handles endpoint membership.

improvements.where: note, ## Method, and P2-6.2 teaching card
improvements.why: The library's quadratic-equations page explicitly checks whether each algebraic root is attainable, while the note says only to solve both branches.
improvements.what: After factorisation, check each proposed sine or cosine value lies in $[-1,1]$ before finding angles; discard impossible branches and explain why.

improvements.why: The existing link text is not the bundle's exact Obsidian chapter names.
improvements.what: Append working links using the bundle's exact names: Builds on [[3 Trigonometry]] and Leads to [[2 Trigonometry]].
